title: Plano recorrido 42K 2026 — official static course map PDF
claims: The official 2026 course map PDF is dated 6 December 2026, 08:15, and shows the start beside the City of Arts and Sciences with the finish at the Ciutat de les Arts i les Ciències.
The map elevation profile states minimum altitude 1.8 m, maximum altitude 18 m and maximum difference 16.2 m; the profile line stays inside the 0-30 m axis with no sustained climb.
The legend marks aid stations with water, Aquarius, fruit, toilets and medical service, three Enervit gel red points, medal engraving, parking, bag drop-off area and rapid assistance points.
The PDF gives no cumulative climb or descent figure and no coordinate track; it is a static plan only, with no redistribution licence attached.
